seo.title: Our people | Illawarra Christian School
seo.description: Meet the leaders, teachers and staff who know your child: a team who share one conviction, that every child deserves to be known, cared for and challenged.

value.title:
Meet the people who
know your child
Our team are passionate about Christian education.
value.text: Behind every ICS student is a team of leaders, teachers and staff who share one conviction. Every child deserves to be known, cared for and challenged.

image.alt: Mr Simon Lainson, Principal of Illawarra Christian School

value.title:
Welcome to
our community
value.message: “I have been part of ICS for more than 25 years, as a teacher, as Principal and as a parent. What keeps me here is the people. We partner with families because we believe a child does best when home and school work together. Here we celebrate learning, enjoy community and seek to serve Christ in everything we do. I’d love for you to come and see it for yourself.”
value.name: Mr Simon Lainson

image.alt: The ICS campus from the air, among the trees below the escarpment

value.title:
Leaders who
love to serve.
value.text: Our executive team leads with faith, experience and a genuine care for every family in our community.

image.alt: Mr Simon Lainson, Principal

people.name: Mr Simon Lainson
people.bio_intro: Simon joined the staff team at Illawarra Christian School in 1999 and was appointed Principal in 2008.
people.bio:
He has a Bachelor of Secondary Education (Humanities and Social Sciences) from the University of Sydney, a Graduate Diploma in Bible and Ministry from Sydney Missionary and Bible College, and a Master of Education (Leadership) from the National Institute of Christian Education.

Simon is married to Sarah, and they have six children. He values the partnership his family enjoys with Illawarra Christian School through his children’s education. Simon is an elder at Wollongong Baptist Church. As a member of the CEN NSW/ACT State Council, Simon plays an active role in the wider Christian education community.

Passionate about equipping staff and students with a faithful, Christ-centred worldview that informs all of life, Simon is excited to be leading a community of Christian educators, parents and students who learn and grow together under God’s grace.
